title: Independent DWG reader and evidence-lane audit
mode: Primary-source open-source repository, API, build metadata, and package-index review
scope: Screen newly surfaced direct DWG reader implementations and distinguish parser lineage from wrappers and normalized models.
Map exact documented operation/version/entity coverage to the current parity plan.
Make any useful external differential implementation-ready without adding a routine dependency, fixture, or support claim.
Keep DWG AcDs transport, ACIS payload decoding, shape semantics, and native consumer qualification as separate evidence stages.

method.limitations: The source review was not a complete ancestry audit and no published wheel was installed or executed. README/API claims and dependency metadata screen candidate roles; they do not qualify runtime behavior or semantic correctness.

sources.name: ezdwg repository and README
sources.observed: Documents a Rust-core/PyO3 read-focused DWG API covering AC1012 through AC1032, a narrow native AC1015 writer, DXF conversion through ezdxf, and version/entity-specific limitations.

sources.name: ezdwg guide: reading files and version matrix
sources.observed: Separates experimental AC1012/AC1014 from later listed versions and distinguishes modelspace, paperspace, all-entity enumeration, layouts, and entity placement.

sources.name: ezdwg Rust core Cargo manifest
sources.observed: The core crate declares encoding_rs as its dependency. This is dependency-graph evidence only; source ancestry still needs audit.

sources.name: ezdwg workspace Cargo manifest and Cargo.lock
sources.observed: The workspace manifest reports 0.16.3 while the reviewed lockfile lists internal ezdwg-core and ezdwg-python packages at 0.12.12; neither libredwg nor acadrust appears in the lockfile. This drift must be reconciled before claiming source-to-wheel correspondence.

sources.name: ezdwg PyPI 0.16.3 artifact metadata
sources.observed: Version 0.16.3 was published 2026-10-17 with macOS universal/ARM64, Linux x86-64/ARM64, and Windows x86-64 wheels; the listed macOS wheel has SHA-256 50414743576011389c2382c7a129da78cdd0b3bf17af05f3beef88597b7ff0c8.

sources.name: ezdwg GitHub releases page
sources.observed: No GitHub Releases were listed at review time, so a package artifact pin and source revision reconciliation are required.

sources.name: acadrust.js README and third-party notice
sources.observed: The JavaScript package is a binding that consumes upstream acadrust as an unmodified Cargo dependency; its notice identifies acadrust 0.3.4. Count it under the ACadRust parser lineage.

sources.name: cad2d-ir README
sources.observed: Its DWG adapter consumes the ezdwg model and maps into a 2D IR, so it is a normalized wrapper and not a second DWG parser vote.

sources.name: cq-acis README and geometry limitations
sources.observed: Describes an experimental, subset-bounded SAT/SAB-to-CadQuery/OpenCascade route that surfaces unsupported geometry; it begins at payload bytes and does not establish DWG AcDs lookup or ownership joins.

sources.name: LibreDWG issue #1411
sources.observed: Reports R2013+ ACIS geometry loss in the AcDs/ACDSDATA carrier path for a specific LibreDWG build. This is an external peer report, not a local reproduction or format authority.

plan_impact.ezdwg: Optional direct DWG read-side differential; dependency graph appears distinct from LibreDWG and ACadRust, but source ancestry and wheel/source correspondence remain to be audited. Limit to documented exact overlaps and independently expected fields.
plan_impact.acadrust_js: Same ACadRust parser lineage; wrapper does not count as an independent DWG implementation.
plan_impact.cad2d_ir: Uses ezdwg and normalizes to 2D IR; useful only for a named normalization behavior, not a separate parser or source graph/3D preservation vote.
plan_impact.acis_acds: Maintain distinct evidence stages for DWG AcDs section transport and owner/key joins, exact payload recovery, ACIS parse completeness, expected shape metrics, and native CAD acceptance.
plan_impact.implementation_change: No local defect, required comparator, permanent test, fixture, dependency, native run, validation cadence change, or support promotion.

repository_state: Plan and receipt only, in a broadly dirty shared worktree. No source, test, fixture, or dependency was changed; no changes were staged or committed.
